steps.name: reveals
steps.expr: const ids=['btn-tok-reveal','btn-enc-reveal','btn-zs-reveal','btn-probe-reveal','btn-layer-reveal','btn-dial-reveal','btn-ner-reveal','btn-qa-reveal'];ids.forEach(i=>document.getElementById(i).click());return ids.map(i=>i+':'+document.getElementById(i).textContent).join(' ')+' | hidden left: '+document.querySelectorAll('[hidden]').length+' | veils: '+document.querySelectorAll('.veil').length+' | score rows on: '+document.querySelectorAll('#score .row.on').length+'/'+document.querySelectorAll('#score .row').length

steps.name: zs
steps.expr: return 'acc: '+document.getElementById('zs-pick-acc').textContent+' | conf cells: '+document.querySelectorAll('#zs-conf td').length+' | bet verdict: '+document.querySelector('#bet-zs .verdict').textContent

steps.name: zsPick
steps.expr: const s=document.querySelector('#zs-pick select'); s.value='politics'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return document.getElementById('zs-pick-acc').textContent+' | python v2 '+D.zeroShot.python.v2.accuracy+' | conf: '+document.querySelectorAll('#zs-conf td').length+' cells'

steps.name: interact
steps.expr: document.querySelector('#fig-bert-btns [data-m=mlm]').click(); const a=document.getElementById('fig-bert-note').textContent.slice(0,30); document.querySelector('#fig-bert-btns [data-m=nsp]').click(); document.querySelector('#fig-heads-btns [data-m=span]').click(); document.querySelector('#fig-ner-btns [data-m=label]').click(); document.querySelector('#dial-knob [data-k=everything]').click(); document.querySelectorAll('#mlm-toks .tok')[5].click(); return 'bert:'+a+' | heads:'+document.getElementById('fig-heads-note').textContent.slice(0,30)+' | ner:'+document.getElementById('fig-ner-note').textContent.slice(0,40)+' | knob:'+document.getElementById('dial-knob-stats').textContent.slice(0,120)+' | mlm:'+document.getElementById('mlm-say').textContent.slice(0,60)

steps.name: nerPreds
steps.expr: document.querySelector('#ner-preds-btns [data-m=predHeadOnly]')?.click(); return 'head-only ents: '+document.querySelectorAll('#ner-preds .ent').length+' wrong: '+document.querySelectorAll('#ner-preds .ent.wrong').length+' | btns hidden: '+document.getElementById('ner-preds-btns').hidden

steps.name: qaFig
steps.expr: const p=document.querySelectorAll('#qa-pick button'); if(p.length){p[p.length-1].click();} return 'qa buttons: '+p.length+' | note: '+document.getElementById('fig-qa-note').textContent.slice(0,160)

steps.name: svgText
steps.expr: let bad=[]; for (const sv of document.querySelectorAll('svg')) { const r=sv.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width===0) continue; const vb=sv.viewBox.baseVal; const sc=r.width/vb.width; for (const t of sv.querySelectorAll('text')) { const b=t.getBBox(); const m=t.getCTM(); if (!m) continue; if (b.x < -2 || b.x+b.width > vb.width+2) bad.push((sv.parentElement.id||sv.parentElement.className)+':'+t.textContent.slice(0,25)); } } return bad.length? 'clipped: '+bad.slice(0,12).join(' | ') : 'no clipped svg text'

steps.name: tokParity
steps.expr: const ck=D.tok.encodeCheck; const w=document.getElementById('live-tok-word'), n=document.getElementById('live-tok-n'); n.value=300; let bad=[]; for (const e of ck){ w.value=e.word; w.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const g=id=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#'+id+' .tok')].map(t=>t.textContent); const b=g('live-bpe'), r=g('live-wp-replay'), l=g('live-wp-longest'); if (b.join(' ')!==e.bpe.join(' ')) bad.push('bpe '+e.word); if (r.join(' ')!==e.replay.join(' ')) bad.push('replay '+e.word); if (l.join(' ')!==e.longest.join(' ')) bad.push('longest '+e.word); } return bad.length? bad.join(' || ') : 'all '+ck.length+' words match python'
